description: EXHAUSTIVE d=64 tile-shape sweep (bf16, hstu). The full block-tile grid over sequence<kM0,kN0,kN0Sub,kN1,kK1,MaxK>: M=km0 {64,128,192}, N=kn0 {32,64,128}, K-stream=kn0sub+kk1 (must be equal; sweep kk1 {32,64}, kn0sub auto-matched in the instance_gen gate), V head tile kn1 {16,32,64}. warp_k FORCED to 32 (16x16x32 MFMA): a tile-overridden d=64 kernel needs WarpK=32 to satisfy the pipeline WarpGemm assertion (WarpK=16/16x16x16 fails to compile), and kK1>=WarpK so kk1=16 is pruned by the instance_gen gate. Invalid combos are skipped by instance_gen (kN0Sub==kK1, kN0%kK1==0, MaxK%kN1==0, kK1>=WarpK). splitkv is off because the split-KV dispatch cannot honor tile-shape overrides. Kernel names get _km0NNN _n0NNN _n0sNNN _n1NNN _k1NNN _wkNN tokens when overridden. ~90 kernels — for finding the best tile shape per d=64 shape, not for quick iteration (use sweep_fast.json for that). Pass the shape inline, e.g. --batch 120 --num-head 4 --seqlen 16384 --hdim 64 --target-size 300.
